I think my magical library can be of some help to you.
Come in, I will make worthy fighters out of your frail soldiers.
My spells are the most potent in the region.

How may I help you stranger?

In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.
"Foolish human you have signed your death warrant by being here!"

Thug 
"Please spare me and I will tell you everything! I know a great secret that can help the Legions Of The Damned rule! I have heard stories about a marked grave. All I know is if you arrive at this grave with the right item you will be invincible."

Arch-Devil 
"Fool! You only provided a small portion of what you know. You had your chance now the rest of the information will die with you. We are more than capable of finding out what the secret is."

Ashkael 
"Hear my words! We are meant to rule with an iron fist. Fire shall burn the lands, go and find the cursed blood of Uther! Witht the blood we will be able to control a powerful creature!"

High Father's Angel 
"I have freed from the dark abyss! I once again pledge my allegiance to the Empire!"

Dark Lachla'an 
"I shall serve Mortis and destroy those who oppose us. The Elves they must be destroyed, I shall destroy every last one of them."
"Appear mighty servant. Arise and serve your master!"

Air Elemental 
"I appear with a message. Uthers' blood once again threatens the Empire. Should the blood be brought to marked grave our troubles will begin anew. We must find the blood ourselves and either protect in our capital or use it ourselves!"

Lachla'an 
"I have must warn you. The Undead Hordes among others are searching for Uther's blood. Should the Hordes find the blood and bring it to the marked grave a Dark Lachla'an shall emerge to spread havoc."
"Dirty grave robbers! I let you live once! Your lives are now forfeit."

Thug 
"Do not kill me! I beg you for mercy! I know of your enemies. As we speak they seek the blood of Uther! Should they find the blood and bring it to the marked grave the days of the Empire shall end."
"The Oracle Elf that once lived here is gone! She could have told us where the blood resides! Now we must find it on our own!"

Ashgan 
"Undead Hordes! We shall release the dark creature with the cursed blood of Uther. Find the blood and bring it the marked grave by the fiery pits!"

Illumielle 
"Fate as assigned us the role of partnering with the Empire.  We shall be cautious for they could turn on us at anytime. Let us work with them until it is necessary to leave them to their own fate!"

Myzrael 
"Heed my words! The Elven Alliance shall work among us. Wisdom suggests that we work along with them and plan for the future when we will be forced to break our treaty!"

Ashkael 
"The the armies of darkness and the fiery armies join for the moment. The Undead Hordes shall be useful as our pawns.  When are through with them we shall discard the lowly pawns."

Ashgan 
"The Legions will serve our purpose and fight our battles. We will team with them until such a time as we decide that their sword is no longer needed. Then we shall double cross the creatures and send them to Mortis!"
"Our city has fallen to the Orcs! We shall start our domination over this realm by taking back our city. Mortis shall reward us by doing so!"
"As I told you Mortis has rewarded us! Let those who cross the Undead Hordes know that their lives are forfeit!"
"There is nothing more than I can learn from these people. We have caputered one of the key cities."
"This city is ours and so are its secrets. The cursed blood of Uther is heavily protected by Manticores. We will need to be prepared to fight off the mighty creature!"
"The grave is protected by a Golem! I do not dare attack this creature. We should avoid the beast at all costs!"
"The Mountain Clans were fools to think that they could keep this realm a secret. We shall exploit the legend of the grave ourselves!"
"Our enemies are searching for away to exploit the grave. If they should succeed we shall be at a disadvantage."
"The Grave Golem is a formidable opponent. If we are to take advantage of the hidden secrets of the grave we are going to have to sneak up on him."
"Victory is ours! The eight cities of the council shall fall to us!"
"Go slowly! Our spies tell us that a menacing Grave Golem is nearby. The Golem will only attack if we approach him. Let us stay away from him for the time being."
"Approach with caution, a Grave Golem is nearby and we are not yet a match for this powerful creature. The tempermental Golem will not attack us unless we are too close."
"We have to watch ourselves the Mountain Clans will not go down without a fight!"
"The Mountain Clans are going to be a problem. I cannot see them accepting the fact that we rule this city!"

"The wolves are dangerous, the spirit wolves are especially tough. If we are going to find the secret of the grave and conquer the realm we must take these creatures into account. Each battle with them leaves us weakened."
